rules.name: Sufficient accrued balance
rules.text: A time off request may not exceed the worker's accrued balance for the selected time off plan as of the request start date.

rules.name: Advance notice
rules.text: Requests of more than 3 consecutive days require at least 14 calendar days of advance notice. Shorter notice requires manager judgement.

rules.name: Restricted period
rules.text: Time off overlapping a restricted period requires an approved exception before it can be granted.

rules.name: Team coverage floor
rules.text: At least 60 percent of a supervisory organization must remain available on every working day of the requested window.

rules.name: Consecutive day ceiling
rules.text: Requests longer than 15 consecutive calendar days are routed to HR Partner review regardless of balance.
